title: Canonical proper integration counit
statement:
In the finite site coordinates for $\ell,E,n,A$, let $T$ be Noetherian with $\ell$ invertible, let $q:\mathbf P^1_T\to T$, and let $r\geq0$ kill $A$ by $\ell^{r+1}$. For every $K\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, identify $C(Lq_e^*K\otimes^L L_P[2])$ with $Lq_p^*CK\otimes^L CL_P[2]$ by the canonical tensorator and pullback square. The coefficient-first proper projection at these objects is invertible. The normalized projective counit in the ordered integration node is its inverse followed by $1\otimes t_q^p$ and the comparison constant right unitor. The trace $t_q^p$ is the supported-Kummer, second-projection trace, not a chosen ordinary trace transport.
